initialExam.title: CGPSC 2026 (Chhattisgarh State Service)
initialExam.description: Chhattisgarh State Service Examination for recruitment to administrative and allied service posts in Chhattisgarh state government.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: General Studies (2 papers). Mains: Hindi, English, Essay, General Studies, Optional, Chhattisgarh GK.
initialExam.jobRole: Deputy Collector, DSP, Naib Tehsildar in Chhattisgarh
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit psc.cg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Government quarters, Pension
